The workspace had two editing surfaces — the collapsed "Assemble course" strip above the desk (`CourseAssemblyTools`) and a second copy of the same controls in the right rail (`CourseTools`) — plus a whole duplicate page (`BlankCourseWorkspace`) for courses without lessons. All three are deleted. Editing now lives in one place: a **Build** view with sections (Details · Outline · Lesson · Documents · Assignments · Artifacts · Cards · People), each with its own filter, counts, and empty states.

The workspace is now four tabs instead of a Desk/Room toggle: **Read · Discuss · Review · Build** (Review only for teachers, Build only for editors). A course with no lessons opens on Build instead of a separate page.

## What you asked for, specifically

- **Adding documents** — an `Add` menu in the header (upload a file, add a link, module/lesson, assignment, quiz, card), an "Add document" button on the lesson itself that attaches straight to that lesson, and a drag-and-drop drop zone in Build → Documents with per-source rename/re-attach/remove.
- **Search** — ⌘K/Ctrl+K command palette over lessons, modules, documents, artifacts, assignments, cards, discussion, shared notes, and members, with keyboard nav and jump-to-result. When nothing matches, the last row hands the query to Keating as a real search request.
- **Comments** — threaded replies (two levels; replies-to-replies join the parent thread), author editing with an "edited" marker, deletion by author or teacher that takes replies and their reactions with it, a per-lesson channel picker plus a new **course-wide thread**, an "Everything" read-only view, and in-thread search. Comment counts show in the outline.
- **Reactions** — emoji reactions on comments, documents, artifacts, and assignments; one per member per emoji, toggling, hover shows who reacted, and they follow the course's `allowPeerComments` rule so no button is a dead click.
- **Other workspaces** — a course switcher in the header (filterable list of your courses, current one checked, links to the library and to planning a new one).
- **Collaborating with Keating** — a Keating panel in the rail with context-aware requests ("Find sources for it", "Draft a quiz", "Read the discussion with me"). These open chat in a new tab with the course loaded and the request **pre-filled in the composer** (new `ask` param → `pendingPrompt`; it never overwrites text you typed and never auto-sends). The workspace also listens for `keating:course-updated` and refreshes, so edits Keating makes appear while you watch.

Also fixed along the way: course outcomes, lesson `estimatedMinutes`, course settings (peer comments / peer deck edits / teacher-access policy), and member roles had no editor anywhere — they do now.

## Data model

`contracts.ts` + `operations.ts`: comments gained optional `lessonId`, `parentId`, `editedAt`; new `course.reactions` collection; new operations `comment.update`, `comment.delete`, `reaction.toggle`, and `settings` in the `course.update` patch. Deletes cascade properly (lesson removal drops its comments/notes and their reactions; artifact/material/assignment removal drops theirs). Comment and reaction ops deliberately don't require the current revision, so concurrent chatter never 409s.

New pure modules — `course-search.ts`, `course-comments.ts`, `course-ask.ts` — so the matching, threading, and hand-off text are testable.
